title: US single release: London Town by Wings | 1978
content:
Wings’ single ‘London Town’ was released in the USA on 21 August 1978.

It came out five months after the London Town album. The b-side was ‘I’m Carrying’.

‘London Town’ entered the Billboard Hot 100 at number 75 on 9 September, and peaked at number 39 on 14 October. It spent a total of eight weeks on the chart.

The single was released on 25 August in the UK.
